note: Adjustable ranges depend on installed upgrades (e.g. race springs/diff unlock sliders). Values below are typical exposed ranges and consensus baselines from a 3-week-old meta. Treat all baselines as starting points to be road-tuned.

categories.label: Tire Pressure
categories.principle: Lower pressure = larger contact patch, more grip, smoother load transfer. Higher = sharper response, lower grip ceiling. A 3 psi shift meaningfully changes behavior. Tune to ~31-33 psi hot.

categories.label: Gearing
categories.principle: Short gearing = faster accel, lower top speed. Long = slower accel, higher top end. Must be tuned while driving — do it last. Shorter final drive for touge/city hairpins; longer for highway speed zones.

categories.label: Alignment
categories.principle: Modest negative camber for cornering grip without killing straight-line traction. Higher caster sharpens turn-in and self-centering.

categories.label: Anti-Roll Bars
categories.principle: Balances rotation. Stiffer front = less understeer-correcting grip front / more stable; stiffer rear = more rotation. Tune relative to drivetrain bias.

categories.label: Springs
categories.principle: Stiffer for smooth road/circuit, softer for dirt/cross-country compliance. Set after tires, before alignment.

categories.label: Ride Height
categories.principle: Lower = lower CG, more road grip. Raise for dirt/cross-country to avoid bottoming out.

categories.label: Damping
categories.principle: Rebound controls how fast the spring returns (~1.5-2x bump as a start). Bump controls compression. Softer damping for rough/dirt surfaces.

categories.label: Aerodynamics / Downforce
categories.principle: More downforce = more cornering grip, lower top speed. Min for drag/top-speed, max for technical circuits — costs PI.

categories.label: Braking
categories.principle: Forward balance = stable braking; rearward = more trail-braking rotation. Lower pressure if locking up under ABS-off.

categories.label: Differential
categories.principle: 0% open, 100% locked. AWD road meta: rear ~55% accel / ~15% decel, center 70-80% rear for launch traction plus rotation.
